pillar_reactions.evidence: The rep tied the pillar directly to the disclosed back history — "remember when you told me that with those back issues... this is why we're going to target that very first thing with also mobility protocols" — and the prospect agreed without questions: "Yeah, I mean, it sounds reasonable. I mean, you know, that's kind of along the lines of what I expected."

The three-variable pitch (what, when and how much you eat, inside a 10-to-8-hour window) drew agreement and a self-disclosure rather than resistance — "Potato chips is one of my weaknesses" — and the sustainability framing matched something he had already said he needed: "it needs to be something I want to maintain long-term". Asked "any questions on nutrition?" he said no.

He asked for the mechanics twice. "So you said, you know, you send videos and stuff like that. But let's say there's three or four sessions a week. Those are sessions that I do on my own and then send videos and he critiques me on. He's not with me in the session" — checking that the coaching was asynchronous rather than live. He accepted the answer once the app, weekly check-in and direct-text access were described.

anchors.raw: the numbers I deal with are big, you know, my expenditures, you know, business are in the many, many tens of thousands per month. So another six grand hit is kind of a lot, but I can easily say, you know, I can do a thousand, you know, like in budgeted, you know, that won't hurt as much
anchors.note: He does not price the programme against other coaching; he prices it against a monthly business cash-flow line. That converts $6,000 from a decision about value into a decision about a billing cycle, and it is what the rep ended up negotiating against. Note the number is self-reported and was never verified — the open-wallet questions that would have tested it were not asked.

anchors.raw: I was probably going to do it on a business credit card, so just charge it as a business expense, because to me, as a business expense, I'm getting it tax-deferred, and I can easily show my accountant that this is business mentorship, whatever
anchors.note: He had already reframed the purchase as a deductible business expense, which lowers the effective price and is a strong buying signal. It also killed the third-party financing route, since financing would not have run through the business card — worth knowing before offering financing to self-employed prospects.

anchors.raw: I drive about 15 minutes to my gym to work out 30 30 minutes and drive back 15 minutes... if I have a solid 30 minute routine at home, maybe I can cut that out and be more efficient and save time
anchors.note: The incumbent is a gym membership he already pays for, but he framed it as a cost in time rather than a cheaper substitute. That is the rare case where an existing solution supports the price instead of undercutting it, and the rep never picked it up or quantified it.

unmet_demand.want: To pay $1,000 per month for six months on autopay against a business credit card — $6,000 total, no premium for spreading it
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The only priced instalment option the rep had was $1,200 per month, a $7,200 total. Rather than an approved no-premium plan, the fallback was a shorter three-month term at $4,000 with a verbal credit toward the six-month price.

unmet_demand.want: Written confirmation that the money paid for the three-month term credits toward a $6,000 six-month total
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The standard agreement documents only the three-month term. The rep could not locate a clause covering the credit and offered "I can send you an email on that. The calls are recorded, so you have my word on this."

unmet_demand.want: Guidance on peptides as part of getting healthier at 51, having already used testosterone supplementation
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Not part of the three-pillar offer. The rep did not decline it — he positioned the programme as the prerequisite and implied the programme would later handle it: "to dial it in, it's good to have the basics covered... And then we can dial in the peptides."
